title: Query ML Diagnostics Monitored Events
description: Queries the Cluster Director / ML Diagnostics Workload Monitoring API (`gcloud alpha mldiagnostics`, `hypercomputecluster.googleapis.com/v1alpha`) on GKE clusters (`>= 1.36.0-gke.4447000`) to cover silent metric-only `PERFORMANCE_DEGRADATION` bottlenecks that do not emit error signatures in Cloud Logging: (1) host cgroup resource saturation (`CPU Utilization Analyzer`, `Host Memory Utilization Analyzer`), (2) accelerator memory saturation (`HBM Capacity Analyzer`, `HBM Bandwidth Analyzer`), (3) silent hardware/fabric throttling (`Thermal Analyzer`, `TPU Throttling Analyzer`, `ICI Link Analyzer`, `ToR NIC Link Analyzer`, `ToR Uplink Congestion`), (4) port-`9431` Prometheus framework stalls (`PyGrain Data Analyzer`, `Async Checkpointing Analyzer`), (5) negative hardware rule-out (`not_detected_analyzers` across all 11 subsystems), and (6) AutoCaptured XProf `.xplane.pb` traces (`profiler_sessions`). Requires the 15-minute duty cycle warmup gate after each `RUNNING` transition (comparing backward-looking `[t-5m, t]` vs. `[t-15m, t]` windows); for crashes, hangs, restarts, preemptions, or `<15m` startup/restore stalls, use Debug Wiki's core Cloud Logging and host/node triage workflows instead.

project_id.description: GCP Project ID where the GKE cluster and ML Diagnostics run reside.

location.description: GCP region or zone where the machineLearningRun is recorded (e.g. us-central1, us-central2).

ml_run_id.description: Explicit machineLearningRun ID (<job-name>-<timestamp>). When empty, discovers runs matching workload_id via machine-learning-run list.

workload_id.description: Workload or JobSet name prefix used to filter machine-learning-run list when ml_run_id is omitted.

event_id.description: Optional specific monitoredEvent ID to describe. When empty, lists and describes all monitored events for each matching ML run.

output_file.description: Output JSON file path storing the queried monitoredEvents and analyzerReports.
